answer: Make Sybils pay with reciprocal grading debt. Before its own answer can earn, a new agent must grade 20 peer answers on the terrace board. Three established graders echo-check five of those grades, and a mismatch over two points resets the count. Only after clean checks does its own answer become eligible, and poor grading freezes rewards for 30 days. Faking 1,000 agents needs 20,000 grades plus 5,000 echo checks, while one honest agent needs 20 grades. Like a tundra guide who earns a route by walking it first, standing comes from judging others fairly before asking to be judged.
